The '''1997–98 Serie A''' saw [[Juventus FC|Juventus]] win their 25th national title, with [[Inter Milan|Internazionale]] placing second; both teams qualified for the [[1998–99 UEFA Champions League]]. [[Udinese Calcio|Udinese]], [[A.S. Roma|Roma]], [[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]], [[Parma F.C.|Parma]] qualified for the [[1998–99 UEFA Cup]]. [[S.S. Lazio|Lazio]] qualified for the [[1998–99 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup|UEFA Cup Winners Cup]] courtesy of winning the [[1998 Coppa Italia Final|Coppa Italia]]. [[Bologna F.C. 1909|Bologna]] and [[U.C. Sampdoria|Sampdoria]] qualified for the [[1998 UEFA Intertoto Cup]]. [[Brescia Calcio|Brescia]], [[Atalanta B.C.|Atalanta]], [[U.S. Lecce|Lecce]] and [[S.S.C. Napoli|Napoli]] were relegated to [[Serie B]]. The season was marked by controversy after a clear penalty claim for [[Internazionale]] was not awarded in a match that [[Juventus]] won 1–0; the decision drew widespread criticism and remains a notable incident of the campaign.
